tasks.title: SEC-001: Fix writing-craft.ts API key header transmission
tasks.description: Refactor analyzeWritingCraftLLM to extract api_key/base_url from llmConfig and send via X-LLM-API-Key/X-LLM-Base-Url headers using callApi extraHeaders param, matching writing.ts pattern

tasks.title: SEC-002: Add validateEntityType to graphAddEntity service layer
tasks.description: Add validateEntityType(entityType) call at the start of graphAddEntity() before engine.createEntity(). Import from ../../utils/cypher-safety.js

tasks.title: SEC-003: Add Cypher safety guard to graphQueryEndpoint
tasks.description: Add a Cypher safety check in graphQueryEndpoint that blocks destructive patterns: DETACH DELETE, DROP, CREATE CONSTRAINT, SET/REMOVE on non-property positions. Allow MATCH, RETURN, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, WITH, UNWIND, CALL (for procedures). Return 403 with error message for blocked patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Destructive Cypher patterns blocked (DETACH DELETE, DROP, CREATE CONSTRAINT)
Read-only patterns allowed (MATCH, RETURN, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT)
403 response with descriptive error for blocked queries
Existing frontend queries (from PersistedEntityTab) still work

tasks.title: ARCH-004: Add workspace context to foreshadow/character APIs
tasks.description: Add workspace?: ProjectWorkspaceContext parameter to plantForeshadow, getForeshadowStats, analyzeCharacterDepth, getCharacterProfile, getCharacterRelationships. Use appendWorkspacePayload or appendLegacyMemoryWorkspacePayload to include workspace in callApi payloads.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace context passed via appropriate append function

tasks.title: ARCH-005: Wire story-bible _workspace parameter
tasks.description: Replace _workspace with workspace parameter and wire it via appendWorkspacePayload in all sb* functions: sbGetEntities, sbGetEntity, sbCreateEntity, sbUpdateEntity, sbDeleteEntity, sbExtractFromManuscript.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 sb* functions use workspace parameter (no underscore prefix)

tasks.title: CORR-002: Add workspace scope to foreshadowPlantEndpoint
tasks.description: In foreshadowPlantEndpoint, call resolveGraphScope(body) and pass the resulting scope context (workspaceId) into the entity properties, so created foreshadow entities are properly scoped.
acceptance_criteria: foreshadowPlantEndpoint resolves workspace scope from request
Workspace ID included in created entity properties
